description: Screen every coin CryptoKeyhole covers by the latest readings of its charts, for example coins with MVRV below 1, funding below zero or price 60% under its high. A condition is field:measure op number, such as market.Mvrv:v<1 or market.PriceUsdClose:p30>10, combined with all(...) or any(...); measures: v the reading, p1 p7 p30 p90 p365 the change in %, d1 ... d365 the change in the chart's unit, z the four-year z-score, q the four-year percentile. get_screener_fields gives the field ids. Without an API key: the first 10 coins at the daily close.

assets.description: Optional coin codes to screen; leave it out for every coin.

interval.description: Resolution: 24h daily. get_metric_metadata gives the intervals a metric offers.

sort.description: A column to sort by (field:measure), or asset.

where.description: The condition, for example all(market.Mvrv:v<1,derivatives.FuturesFundingRatePerpetual:v<0). Leave it out for every coin.

name: screen_assets
title: Screen coins
